editor: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: illustrated engineering infographic for GitHub PR. Create a polished 1536x1024 landscape infographic inspired by Sekiro, with a shinobi in a weathered orange cloak, katana, falling red maple leaves and Japanese ink textures. Original illustration, no game logo, no watermark. Strong readable modern typography, cream parchment, charcoal ink, scarlet problem accents, teal solution accents. Title exactly 'PRESERVE EVERY EDIT'. Subtitle exactly 'Parallel calls. One shared file.' Structure two clear equal panels BEFORE and AFTER, with a thin architecture strip at bottom. BEFORE: two small scrolls labeled 'Edit A' and 'Edit B' point to separate copies both labeled 'Old file', then converge onto one file labeled 'One change lost'. Small caption 'Both calls report success'. AFTER: the two scrolls feed one ordered queue labeled 'Per-file queue', then one file with two visible checkmarks labeled 'Both changes saved'. Small caption 'Different files stay parallel'. Bottom strip exact labels 'Cline agent' then 'Editor executor' then 'File on disk', connected by arrows. The actual bug is concurrent read-modify-write, not deleted whole files. Game imagery decorates margins and must not obscure the diagram or imply security content. Few short labels, large legible type, no code blocks.
